name: @blueshed/delta
description: Delta-doc — JSON-Patch document sync with SQLite and Postgres backends, WebSocket transport, and reactive client signals

scripts.prepare: bun -e "import { cpSync, existsSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'; const from = 'node_modules/@blueshed/railroad/.claude/skills/railroad'; if (existsSync(from)) { rmSync('.claude/skills/railroad', { recursive: true, force: true }); cpSync(from, '.claude/skills/railroad', { recursive: true }); }"
scripts.test: bun test tests/core.test.ts tests/cli.test.ts tests/walk-plan.test.ts tests/server.test.ts tests/sqlite.test.ts tests/auth.test.ts tests/railroad-client.test.ts tests/path-json.test.ts tests/path-sqlite.test.ts tests/path-pglite.test.ts tests/client.test.ts tests/codegen.test.ts tests/dom-ops.test.ts tests/install-skills.test.ts tests/kinds.test.ts tests/kinds-pglite.test.ts tests/readme.test.ts tests/recipe.test.ts tests/examples.test.ts tests/file.test.ts tests/ledger.test.ts tests/local.test.ts tests/package-exports.test.ts tests/schema.test.ts tests/sqlite-custom.test.ts tests/sqlite-fanout-scope.test.ts tests/sqlite-isolation.test.ts tests/sqlite-processes.test.ts tests/owns-sqlite.test.ts tests/owns-pglite.test.ts tests/ledger-0.10.0-sql.test.ts tests/law-driver.test.ts tests/migrate.test.ts tests/schema-contract.test.ts tests/writes.test.ts
scripts.ci: bun run db:up && bun check && bun check -p examples/kanban && bun run test:all; code=$?; bun run db:down; exit $code
